onboarding.greetingDesc: Choose the greeting that will accompany every memorisation session at home.

onboardingStep2.description: Each child keeps their own memorisation, targets, and progress.

home.title: Memorisation day · {name}
home.subtitle: A light daily moment with your child and the Qur'an—zero pressure, full of joy.
home.chooseOne: Pick just one activity today. Your loving presence is the best gift.
home.noTargetsBody: Spend 5 gentle minutes introducing a new verse or reviewing together.

targets.newStory: One verse at a time, in 5 warm minutes of quality time.
targets.reviewStory: Invite your child to interact and connect verses comfortably.
targets.completeStory: Today’s warm session is complete. Thank you for accompanying your little one with love.

recommendations.title: Review moments to share
recommendations.body: Pick one or two short ranges to revisit together. Zero pressure—it is completely fine to leave the rest for another day.

settings.lightBody: A bright display with high contrast
settings.familyBody: Used throughout your family’s memorisation journey.

guardianGreeting.title: Guardian title

settings.childrenBody: Choose a profile to view or update its details.

settings.audioBody: Every recording plays verse by verse from the Al Quran Cloud CDN. Ayman Sowaid is selected by default.
settings.backupBody: Download a backup from the old device, then import it on the new one.
settings.backupReady: Backup downloaded successfully. Save this file somewhere safe.
settings.backupFailed: Could not create the backup. Please try again shortly.
settings.dangerBody: Deletes family profiles, targets, memorisation, and history from this device.
settings.welcomeBody: Reset the Memorisation Companion popup so it appears again when opening the home page.
settings.welcomeReset: Show again when the home page opens
settings.deleteChildBody: Today’s targets and saved memorisation for {name} will also be deleted when settings are saved. This action cannot be undone.
settings.resetBody: Data cannot be recovered unless you have exported a backup. You will return to the home page.

review.title: Review
review.howBody: Read the prompt, give your child a moment to answer, then compare the next verse together.

review.oneVerse: This range contains only one verse.
review.arabicLoadError: The Arabic text could not be loaded.
review.arabicUnavailable: The Arabic text is not available yet.

practice.listenBody: The verse will play {count} times, then move gently into repetition.
practice.repeatBody: Guide the child slowly, then they repeat. Tap Smoothly done after each round; replay the audio if needed.
practice.giveTime: Give your child time to find the connection, then continue together.
practice.bridgeHelper: Invite your child to continue from verse {start} to verse {end}.
practice.surahHelper: Connect the surah little by little, one block at a time.
practice.cardHelper: Connect verses {start} to {end}, then continue to the next verse.
practice.audioError: Audio could not be played. Check your connection and try again.
practice.verseLoadError: The verses could not be loaded.
practice.verseUnavailable: The verses are not available yet.

audio.title: Listen to Qur’an
audio.body: Choose a range, then let a calm recitation accompany your home.
audio.searchPlaceholder: Search by surah name or number
audio.searchHint: Type a surah name, number, or Arabic text.
audio.surahNotFound: Surah not found. Try another name or number.
audio.rangeDescription: Focus on a specific memorised part
audio.bismillahTranslation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
audio.downloadError: Download failed. Try again with a stable connection.

agent.title: Accompany {name}
agent.greeting: Assalamu’alaikum, {role}. How is {childName}'s mood right now?
agent.advice: Memorisation is not a burden. When a child is tired or fussy, taking a pause is an act of love.
agent.thinking: Your memorisation companion is preparing advice…
agent.connectionError: The AI endpoint is unavailable. Make sure the app is running with npm run dev.
agent.adviceUnavailable: {message} The local gentle advice is still available.
agent.invalidResponse: The AI endpoint returned an invalid response ({status}).
agent.unsupportedResponse: The AI response does not match the child’s current condition.
agent.fallbackAdvice: A hard day can still move slowly. Closeness to the Qur’an grows from safety, not pressure.
agent.pauseChosen: We chose a pause for {childName}. That is okay—safety comes before targets.
agent.actionChosen: A small step has been chosen for {childName}. Thank you for accompanying them gently.
agent.maxTargetsReached: Today's active targets have reached the limit (max 3 active targets). Please complete one of the active targets before adding a new one.
agent.progressPlaceholder: For example: Aisyah memorised Al-Ikhlas verses 1–4 and reviewed An-Nas 1–3.
agent.progressClarification: A range does not match a saved memorised range. Edit or clarify the exact verses first.
agent.progressUnavailable: Progress could not be understood. Please try again.
agent.directLogDescription: Log new memorisation or review directly today without following the guided program.

advice.tantrumBody: When {child} is upset, there is no target to chase. Offer a calm presence, then return to the Qur’an when the moment feels safe.
advice.playTitle: Let play be accompanied by Qur’an
advice.playBody: {child} wants to play. Put on a gentle recitation as a companion; closeness to the Qur’an can grow without feeling like a task.
advice.restBody: {child} does not seem ready right now. Choose a pause, a cuddle, or a calm activity; memorisation can continue when body and heart feel ready.
advice.reviewBody: {child} has {count} memories ready to revisit. Choose one short range, then listen and connect it gently.
advice.firstBody: Begin with just 1–2 verses of Al-Fatihah in a warm moment. The goal is not speed; it is for {child} to feel close to and happy with the Qur’an.
advice.nextBody: Choose just 1–2 verses; {child}’s closeness to the Qur’an matters more than covering a lot at once.
advice.celebrateBody: Today’s target is complete and {child} still has energy. Keep any next step light so the session stays joyful.
advice.closeBody: All of today’s targets are complete. Say, “MashaAllah, thank you for trying,” then let the memorisation rest until tomorrow.
advice.focusBody: {count} targets are still waiting. Begin with {range}; play the reciter {repeat}× slowly, and praise every effort.
advice.maxTargetsReachedBody: Wonderful! There are currently {count} active targets waiting. Let's guide {child} to complete one of them before adding any more targets.

addTarget.surahUnavailableError: That surah is not available in the Juz 30 list.
addTarget.rangeError: Verse range for QS. {name} must be between 1–{max}.
addTarget.overlapWarning: This verse range is already memorized or in review phase. Use Review to practise it.
addTarget.reviewCustomNotice: Choose a surah and verse range to review.
